warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Switch between the specified Growth and Enterprise plan tenants when their tenant identifiers are not provided; Open, build, and submit custom reports with user-defined fields and formulas; Verify that the Custom Report Builder is absent or refused on Growth and available on Enterprise

args.need: sign in as the Tenant Admin on the Growth tenant and the Enterprise tenant, perform the same Custom Report Builder workflow with custom fields and formulas on both, and report whether Growth refuses or omits it while Enterprise allows it

steps.note: No catalog step can access the plan-specific Custom Report Builder or compare its availability across tenants.
